messages:
maria: Heads-up — found a broken link in docs/model-onboarding.md that points to an old S3 URL. Noticed this when following the onboarding checklist. Can someone pick this up? :eyes:

doc-bot: Created issue #142 in docs repo for broken links (labels: docs, triage).

olga: I can take this. Maria, can you paste the exact markdown line?

maria: Sure — it's this chunk:

```markdown
For model weights, see: [weights](https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-models/weights/v1.tar.gz)
```

That S3 path 404s. We should either update to the new GCS path or add a redirect.

olga: Thanks. I'll open a PR to replace with the canonical storage path and add frontmatter redirect. Prefer to point to `gs://redwood-models/weights/v1.tar.gz` and include an external redirect note.

jake: If you use frontmatter redirects we should also add a tiny note in the changelog so integrators know the path changed.

sam: Also please run the linkcheck job locally (`scripts/linkcheck.sh`) before merging — CI sometimes misses external 302s.

ben: There's also a thumbnail image referenced in the onboarding that points to the same s3 bucket (docs/img/model-diagram.png). I hit a 403 on that earlier. Might be same root cause.

olga: Good catch, Ben. I'll update both the link and the image path in the same PR and add a redirect entry. PR description will list modified files and the linkcheck output.

maria: Thanks much. If you want a quick review ping me — I can confirm the onboarding checklist still works for new hires.

olga: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/458 — title: "docs: replace old s3 links with canonical storage + redirects". Includes updated frontmatter and a changelog entry. @maria @jake PTAL. :thumbsup:

doc-bot: Issue #142 marked "in-progress" and linked to PR #458.

jake: Quick review done — small nit on wording in the changelog. Left inline comment.

olga: Addressed Jake's nit and pushed a fix. Running `scripts/linkcheck.sh` now — all links pass locally.

ben: Verified the image renders in the preview.

maria: LGTM, thanks everyone.

doc-bot: PR #458 merged and issue #142 closed. Release note: docs patch (internal).
